brief:
The United Nations has documented 1,540 assaults by settlers since the beginning of 2026, the Ma'an news agency reported. The attacks have targeted Palestinian communities across occupied territories, damaging homes, agricultural land, and infrastructure.

The documented incidents represent a sharp rise in settler violence over recent months. Attacks have ranged from isolated incidents to coordinated operations, often occurring in areas with minimal Israeli security presence or intervention. The UN's documentation effort establishes a systematic record of the incidents for potential future accountability measures.
title: UN documents 1,540 settler attacks since start of 2026
